ways.label: St Arnaud to Boyle settlement

start.name: Eastern end of Kerr Bay
start.quote: the eastern end of Kerr Bay

end.name: Shelter and car park at SH7 by the Boyle settlement
end.quote: the shelter and car park at SH7 by the Boyle settlement

evidence: Beginning at the eastern end of Kerr Bay, the Lakehead Track wanders through forest, crossing several shallow streams and shingle screes.
Turn off SH63 at St Arnaud onto Kerr Bay Road and continue on to Kerr Bay.
The track starts at the eastern end of the bay.
A vehicle track is joined and followed down the valley to the shelter and car park at SH7 by the Boyle settlement.

doubts: Start ref F6 is the road end where Kerr Bay Track meets Kerr Bay Road; the text says the Lakehead Track starts at the eastern end of Kerr Bay off Kerr Bay Road, which I take to be that road end, but the track named there is Kerr Bay Track, not Lakehead Track. End ref F4 (Saint James Walkway meets Magdalen Valley Road, by Boyle Village) chosen because the way follows the walkway to the car park; the text says the car park is 'at SH7' (Lewis Pass Rd), and F2 (unnamed track meets Lewis Pass Road) is the other candidate. The first leg is headed 'St Arnaud to Lakehead Hut/Coldwater Hut' and 'The track from Coldwater Hut' is mentioned, so Coldwater Hut may be an alternative first-night hut; the text does not describe walking to it, so it is not in the way. Whether Magdalen Hut ('30 minutes from this second bridge') is on the way or off it is not stated. The Boyle village access point is the southern 'entrance/exit', i.e. the same place as the end, given for walking the route in reverse. Lake Constance ref T45 chosen for the text's 'Rotopohueroa/Lake Constance' (the route follows its shoreline). No whole-route distance given.
